containers.name: prod
containers.description: Root of the prod HDFS environment.

containers.name: gold_safe
containers.description: This pipeline has no raw or cleansed zone -- it queries Hive directly (prod_safe_mymo.register, prod_safe_mymo.deactivation) and writes its output straight here.

containers.name: datalake_gold_safe
containers.description: Datalake job outputs, grouped by job name.

containers.name: mymo_register_data_extraction_gold_safe
containers.description: Output of the datalake-mymo-register-data-extraction-spark job, split into a normal/ and a secureplus/ subfolder by application_mode. Each subfolder holds a daily YYYYMMDD-dated delta file.

containers.name: mymo_register_normal_gold_safe
containers.description: Log of MyMo normal registration data, SUMO channel only. File: DELTAMyMo_RegisterFromSUMO_yyyymmdd.csv (or mymo_register.csv header-only when there is no data for the day).

columns.name: actual_deactivated_datetime
columns.description: Actual deactivated datetime from MyMo, null if not yet deactivated

columns.name: deactivated_datetime
columns.description: Deactivated datetime, time truncated to 00:00:00, null if not yet deactivated

containers.name: mymo_register_secureplus_gold_safe
containers.description: Log of MyMo secure plus registration data, SUMO channel only. File: DELTAMyMoSecurePlus_RegisterFromSUMO_yyyymmdd.csv (or mymo_register.csv header-only when there is no data for the day).

columns.name: actual_deactivated_datetime
columns.description: Actual deactivated datetime from MyMo, null if not yet deactivated

columns.name: deactivated_datetime
columns.description: Deactivated datetime, time truncated to 00:00:00, null if not yet deactivated
